command: python3 -B grafiti_p12_reproduce.py --run --archives data/cinc2012/set-a.zip data/cinc2012/set-b.zip data/cinc2012/set-c.tar.gz --seed 0 --device cuda --threads 4 --epochs 200 --batch-size 128 --out artifacts/p12_seed0.json
published_target: to be read from the paper by the project lead

architecture.scalar_transition: affine node/edge maps before final graph layer
architecture.query_policy: Observed future labels define requested edges; no values exposed
architecture.timestamp_api: Explicit context_times and target_times, normalized to corpus maximum

protocol: local released original P12 code; see PROTOCOL_GRAFITI_P12.md

normalization.scope: all available patients/all hours BEFORE split
